description: This PHP source file defines the RestApi class which implements a RESTful API server for managing and interacting with a test management system, including projects, test plans, test cases, test suites, builds, platforms, keywords, and test case executions. It incorporates authentication, permission checking, and various CRUD operations for test artifacts, utilizing the Slim framework and PSR-7 interfaces.

classes.name: RestApi
classes.description: A class providing REST API endpoints for test management operations including project, test plan, build, test case, suite, platform, keyword, and execution management, with authentication and permission control.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates requests via API key from headers, setting user context or returning 401 error.

methods.name: setContentTypeJSON
methods.description: Middleware to set response header Content-Type to application/json.

methods.name: whoAmI
methods.description: Returns information about the current authenticated user.

methods.name: testprojects
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve test projects accessible to the user.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Internal method to fetch projects based on optional ID and options.

methods.name: getProjectTestCases
methods.description: Retrieves latest versions of test cases within a project, including associated keywords and custom fields.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project based on provided JSON payload.

methods.name: getProjectTestPlans
methods.description: Retrieves test plans associated with a specific project.

methods.name: getPlanBuilds
methods.description: Retrieves builds for a specified test plan identified by API key.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build under a specific test plan, checking for permissions and duplicate names.

methods.name: updateBuild
methods.description: Updates an existing build's properties, with permission checks.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan within a project.

methods.name: updateTestPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing test plan.

methods.name: createTestCaseExecution
methods.description: Creates a new test case execution record, verifying environment, permissions, and associations.

methods.name: createTestSuite
methods.description: Creates a new test suite.

methods.name: addPlatformsToTestPlan
methods.description: Associates platforms with a test plan after validation.

methods.name: createTestCase
methods.description: Creates a new test case, processing nested steps and mandatory attributes.

methods.name: createKeyword
methods.description: Creates a new keyword linked to a test project.

methods.name: buildPropMapping
methods.description: Returns a mapping between property names and database fields for builds.

methods.name: buildTestCaseObj
methods.description: Constructs a test case object from input, ensuring mandatory attributes and relations.

methods.name: checkExecutionEnvironment
methods.description: Verifies that the environment (test plan, build, platform, test case) is valid for execution, returning relevant IDs and details.

methods.name: checkRelatives
methods.description: Ensures test project and suite exist and are properly linked.

methods.name: userHasRight
methods.description: Checks if the current user has specified rights within a certain context.

methods.name: getStdOp
methods.description: Returns a standard success response object.

methods.name: getStdIDKO
methods.description: Returns a standard error response object with negative ID.

methods.name: byeHTTP500
methods.description: Generates a 500 Internal Server Error response with optional message.

methods.name: msgFromException
methods.description: Formats exception message including line number.
